description: This file defines a React hook named `useRPSGame` that manages the state and logic for a Rock-Paper-Scissors game, including score persistence, user choices, game outcomes, and feature toggles.

methods.name: useRPSGame()
methods.description: Main hook managing game state, persistence, and user actions for the Rock-Paper-Scissors game.

methods.name: selectChoice
methods.description: Handles a player's choice, computes the computer's choice, determines the result, updates scores and game state.

methods.name: playAgain
methods.description: Resets the current round state to allow replaying without affecting scores.

methods.name: resetScores
methods.description: Resets all scores and game state, and clears persisted data.

methods.name: togglePersonality
methods.description: Toggles the AI personality feature if enabled.
